model: Depth Anything V2 Small, author vits checkpoint
preprocessing: Unchanged author image2tensor: BGR decode, RGB /255, aspect-preserving OpenCV cubic resize lower-bound with dimensions rounded to multiples of 14, ImageNet normalization, NCHW FP32. Save actual tensors and hashes. No source geometry is an input to the model.

images.name: closeup
images.scope: Visual only; original float-coordinate geometry control failed.

images.name: street
images.scope: Visual plus selected collision-hit comparison; integer-coordinate projection control passed.

precision: FP32 CPU reference and DirectML first. If cost fails, one FP16 conversion with FP32 graph inputs/outputs; keep failed conversion artifacts. No retraining or source-code architecture changes.

parity_limits.normalization: Divide absolute error by CPU output range; retain raw errors, no affine output alignment.

timing: 5 warmups and 20 synchronized model calls for first image, 1 warmup and 5 calls for second. Include upload/readback; exclude preprocessing, visualization and export. Game/Workbench stopped. DirectML RX 7800 XT index 0, no CPU execution fallback. Retain every call and provider profile.
cost_scope: Initial feasibility ceiling for a 30FPS combined-render experiment, informed by the measured reduced-render headroom. This is not whole-application performance or the previous 10ms aspirational GPU allocation. A live path must include composition, transfer and full game timing before acceptance.
geometry_check: Use only street mode 0. Keep fraction in (0,1), unit normal, and either named Houses/Commercial meshes or empty mesh with upward normal Y>0.5. Exclude vegetation, props, windows/doors, railings and other unselected meshes. Axial distance is 250*fraction*dot(ray_direction,camera_forward); require 1..200m. Compare predicted ordering with inverse axial distance. Fit affine inverse-depth scale on checkerboard (x+y)%2==0, report reserved odd cells without refit. This spatial split is not an independent-scene generalization test.
visual_checks: Inspect both complete RGB and relative-depth maps, with explicit pole/roof/opening/foliage mismatch review. A matching broad road gradient is insufficient for per-pixel lighting or cover correctness. No lighting composition, normal reconstruction, temporal or live integration before this bounded evaluation.
